title: Fuyao release metadata (contract v1)
description: Authoritative schema for release.json at the root of every published release directory. It keeps the legacy fields already consumed by the web-server health check (schemaVersion, releaseId, createdAt, reasons) and adds the versioned snapshot identity: which theme built the release, the digests of the three inputs it was built from, and the routing metadata the server needs (SPA fallback and URL conventions).

schemaVersion.description: Legacy release metadata version kept for existing health-check readers.

releaseId.description: Unique release directory name. '.' and '..' are rejected as directory-traversal names.

reasons.description: Why the release was produced; mirrored from the deploy request.

manifestDigest.description: Digest of the exact theme.json this release was built from.

inputs.description: Digests of the build-input snapshot this release was built from; enables per-site rollback to an exact content/theme/configuration triple.

spaFallback.description: Mirrors the theme manifest outputs.spaFallback for this release.

urlConventions.description: Mirrors the theme manifest outputs.urlConventions for this release.

dateTime.description: RFC 3339 timestamp. The pattern checks the shape; format: date-time (enforced by the Go validator via AssertFormat) rejects impossible calendar dates.
